_meta.description: product-service-catalogue-public task 1.1: the fields a service needs in the public catalogue. A service is a product of type service (one schema, not a second one). Tariffs, audience, publishedAt and languages already ship in 94-product-catalogue-fields.json and keep their shape; this fragment adds the rest, all optional, so every existing product stays valid. Who may read a service without signing in is decided by the public rules on product in 99-zzz-register-access.json, which read publishFrom and publishUntil.

summary.title: Summary
summary.description: One or two sentences that say what the service is, for the catalogue listing.

contentBlocks.title: Content
contentBlocks.description: The sections of the service page in the catalogue, such as what you need and how long it takes.

uplReference.title: UPL reference
uplReference.description: The service's entry in the national list of government products (UPL), as its URI.

publishFrom.title: Published from
publishFrom.description: The first day the service is shown in the public catalogue. Empty means it is not published.

publishUntil.title: Published until
publishUntil.description: The first day the service is no longer shown in the public catalogue. Empty means it stays published.

applyUrl.title: Apply link
applyUrl.description: Where a resident or business applies for the service, such as the online form.

channels.title: Channels
channels.description: How the service can be requested.
